query:
INSERT INTO reminder_deliveries
             (id, user_id, plant_id, care_task_id, due_date, due_at, created_at, updated_at)
             VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
             ON CONFLICT(user_id, plant_id, care_task_id, due_date)
             DO UPDATE SET updated_at = excluded.updated_at
